content.short: HoneyCoin offers cross-border payments, multi-currency wallets, virtual cards and treasury tools.
content.description: HoneyCoin serves businesses in emerging markets with cross-border payments, multi-currency wallets, virtual cards, stablecoin minting and treasury management in one platform. Monad's documentation lists it among onramps. Stablecoins found genuine product-market fit in these corridors first, where the alternative is slow and expensive correspondent banking.
